body.name: Gaussian-multiplier simultaneous band
body.construction: Conditionally on the sample, draw \(\xi_i\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}N(0,1)\), form \(T^\star=\max_{\ell\in\mathcal L}|n^{-1/2}\sum_i\xi_i\widehat G_{i,\ell}|/\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{\ell\ell}}\), take its exact conditional \(1-\alpha\) quantile \(\widehat c_{1-\alpha}\), and report \(I_{\ell,n}=[\widehat\theta_\ell\mathbin{-}\widehat c_{1-\alpha}\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{\ell\ell}/n},\widehat\theta_\ell\mathbin{+}\widehat c_{1-\alpha}\sqrt{\widehat\Sigma_{\ell\ell}/n}]\).
